profile.name: qwen3-coder-next-q8-cuda13
profile.description: The deployment this manifest was measured against: one 96 GB Blackwell card, CUDA 13, a Q8_0 Qwen3-Coder-Next served at 98304 tokens, and a bge-m3 embedding worker whose vectors were shown bit-identical to the worker it replaced.
profile.notes: A profile, not a requirement. Nothing here names a host, an account, a card or a filesystem path: the machine-specific values (root, GPU UUID, port) are supplied to bootstrap-runtime.sh, never written here.

excluded.reason: Reconstructible runtime only. These exist in some deployments as the sediment of past migrations; they are deliberately NOT part of what a bootstrap rebuilds, and not versioned.

llama_cpp.revision_policy: An immutable commit, never a branch. A moving ref is not a reproducibility contract: the binary that serves today would differ from the one measured, with nothing recording that it changed.

model.integrity_policy: Size is the cheap check and runs every time; sha256 reads 79 GB and runs only when asked for. The hashes are the publisher's own, recorded so a shard can be proven rather than assumed -- a truncated or half-resumed download has the wrong size, but a corrupted one does not.

embedding.semantics: The CLIENT owns model, prefix, cap, normalisation and batching; the server owns device, dtype and loading. The probe values are what this profile's client asks for, recorded so a bootstrap can verify the answer has the right shape.

server_fixed_flags.reason: Decided by server/inference/serve.sh for every deployment, listed here so verification can prove the launcher still emits them rather than trusting that it does.
